text:
rebecca_cs: Heads up — AuroraEdge (dedicated eval) token/embedding volume cratered to ~11% overnight. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Can we triage before the AM QBR? :warning:

david_se: Looking. Any clear 5xx/401/429 pattern or did they throttle jobs?

kai_metrics: Quick numbers: tokens/hr baseline ~5.6k -> 620 during drop window. Error breakdown: 3% 401, 9% 429, negligible 5xx. Drop starts ~2025-12-08 01:20 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/nb/auroraedge/usage (internal)

nora_ae: New procurement lead (L. Gomez) started last week; they kicked off a competitive embed pilot with BlueSparrow. Procurement said cost is top of mind and they paused some nightly ETLs yesterday.

paul_onboard: Onboarding logs: a new scheduler was deployed to their infra that batches jobs aggressively at 01:15 UTC — we see burst patterns. If our org-level token bucket was low that would produce 429 cascades. I can push a small resume test job.

runbook_bot: [ALERT] customer-auroraedge: sudden-usage-drop detected. Suggested runbook: cs-triage-rate-limit + cs-offer-cost-safety. Incident ID: INC-AE-20251208-11

david_se: Running synthetics to the dedicated host + checking edge limiter. If bursts hit, retries can amplify 429s. Will run a targeted probe.

david_se: Probe: 60 reqs -> 52 OK, 8 429. Edge logs show bursts from 10.5.32.0/24 (new scheduler NAT) triggering the org token bucket. Validator healthy (low 401).

kai_metrics: SQL I ran to pin timing:

```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, sum(tokens) tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'auroraedge' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 72;
```

Drop window aligns with 2025-12-08 01:15 UTC. CSV uploaded: /shared/auroraedge/2025-12-08-drop.csv

rebecca_cs: Proposed actions:
- David: add new NAT CIDR to org allowlist and temporarily increase token-bucket for auroraedge to absorb burst (owner @david_se). ETA 45m.
- Paul: run a small restart/warmup job and confirm observed recovery (owner @paul_onboard). ETA 2h.
- Kai: prepare an hourly baseline vs drop slide for QBR (owner @kai_metrics). ETA 3h.
- Nora: outreach to L. Gomez with a cost-safety offer (10% credit + embed burst discount) and ask if they'd like a short cost/latency comparison vs BlueSparrow (owner @nora_ae). ETA EOD.

paul_onboard: Will include a safe-chunking example to avoid bill surprises when they resume.

david_se: Applied temp allowlist + increased bucket. 429s dropped from 9% -> 1.2% in 12m. Monitoring link: https://infra.redwood.internal/inc/INC-AE-20251208-11

runbook_bot: [RECOVERY] INC-AE-20251208-11: traffic recovered to ~87% baseline after allowlist and warmup restart. Incident auto-resolved.

kai_metrics: Recovery CSV: /shared/auroraedge/2025-12-08-recovery.csv. Traffic at 87% ~40m post-fix.

nora_ae: L. Gomez asked for the cost-safety details; I'll propose a 30-min QBR/demo and include the burst discount.

rebecca_cs: Good work. If we don't sustain >75% baseline for 24h, escalate to renewal-engage. Follow-ups: David confirm permanent NAT mapping plan, Paul confirm restart success, Kai finalize slides, Nora send outreach. Reconvene only if regression. :thumbsup:
